tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background and the dot-grid canvas behind the path map and lesson end.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs and the lesson step area.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, menus and popovers that sit above surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: the mock-screen frame background, progress tracks, code-like areas.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers and card borders that do not carry meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, unselected choice cards); 3:1 on surface and canvas.

tokens.name: grid-dot
tokens.usage: Dots of the canvas grid pattern. Decorative only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on canvas, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata, on canvas and surface (6.5:1 or more).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Ultraviolet. Primary buttons, the selection frame and its handles, links, active nav. Text on surface passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background of a selected choice and of brand chips.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Brand-coloured text on brand-soft.

tokens.name: energy
tokens.usage: Coral. XP, streak, celebration and the cursor in the mark. A fill, never body text on light surfaces.

tokens.name: on-energy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an energy fill.

tokens.name: energy-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind energy-ink text: XP and streak pills.

tokens.name: energy-ink
tokens.usage: Coral as text on surface and energy-soft.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Correct answers: icon, border, and text on surface. Always with a check icon and a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the right-answer feedback sheet.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Text on success-soft.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Wrong answers and destructive actions: icon and border. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the wrong-answer feedback sheet and error fields.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Text on danger-soft and error messages on surface.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings and streak-at-risk notices, with an icon.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind warning text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid with 2px offset. Distinct from the brand selection frame.
